code_only_features.evidence: prompts/reassuring.py defines REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX and apply_prefix()/apply_suffix(); training/gen_calm_data.py:_build_reassured_plan() at lines 38-46 actually prepends the calming prefix to the first task prompt and appends the calming suffix to every rejection turn, and these reassured turns are the ones fed to the subject model in the rollout loop (gen_calm_data.py:81-91 uses reassured_turns for histories[i]). So the subject genuinely receives distress-softening text during these rollouts. Note: it executes only in the calm-DATA generation path; the Section-2 distress eval (eval/rollout.py, eval/conditions.py) applies NO reassurance.
